description: DESTRUCTIVE — all data is lost. REQUIRES confirm = exact hostname (from get_vps_status) or 'DELETE'. Agent must explicitly confirm with the human before calling. Wipes and reinstalls the VPS with the given OS image (`os_id` from list_plans). Provisioning runs asynchronously; poll `get_vps_status`. Requires: token + confirm (hostname or DELETE). Destroys all data.

confirm.description: Required. Safety confirmation: the server's exact hostname (from get_vps_status) or the literal "DELETE". ALL data is erased — ask the human first.

os_id.description: Required. OS image id from this plan's `available_os` in list_plans, integer, e.g. 4 (Ubuntu 24.04).

service_id.description: Optional. Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: reinstall_vps
title: Reinstall OS
